subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for the long-name Telegram `/model` picker bug after rerunning the lost Telegram QA shard?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same bug, and this one appears safer because it preserves existing short callback formats, but canonical selection and final CI rerun are maintainer-owned merge decisions.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Rerun the lost Telegram QA shard and, if green, land this token-guarded fallback as the narrow fix for the linked issue.

options.title: Use the broader competing PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 only if maintainers prefer rewriting all model-selection callbacks and accept the extra compatibility risk.

options.title: Pause both duplicate PRs
options.body: Keep the bug open and ask for a maintainer-owned replacement only if neither contributor branch is acceptable as the canonical callback contract.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Rerun the lost Telegram QA shard and, if green, land this token-guarded fallback as the narrow fix for the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent current-main owner for the touched Telegram picker files and release carry-forward.
